meta.note: 중급. 오답은 되묻기가 아니라 '잘못 들었을 때 할 법한 자연스러운 응답'. 형식으로 정답 식별 불가. A=상대(트리거 turn3), B=학습자 3지선다, 정답 비-에코, 각 선택지 kr.

dialogue.text: Would you like meat or cheese?

choices.text: I'll go with cheese.
choices.explain: 'meat or cheese' 선택을 정확히 듣고 하나를 골랐어요.

choices.text: Sure, that sounds fine.
choices.explain: 선택 질문을 'Would you like a meal?'처럼 예/아니오로 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: I'm meeting someone at seven.
choices.explain: 'meat(고기)'를 'meet(만나다)'로 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: Yes, a big basket of them.
choices.explain: 감자튀김이 함께 나오냐는 걸 정확히 듣고 답했어요.

choices.text: Ugh, are there bugs in here?
choices.explain: 'fries'를 'flies(파리)'로 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: No, I'm eating by myself today.
choices.explain: 'fries'를 'friends(친구들)'로 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: Some ice cream, please.
choices.explain: 디저트를 권하는 걸 정확히 듣고 답했어요.

choices.text: Oh, have you been to the desert?
choices.explain: 'dessert(디저트)'를 'desert(사막)'로 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: Aw, that's kind of you to say.
choices.explain: 'dessert'를 'you deserve it(자격 있다)'처럼 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: Yeah, the big white one.
choices.explain: 비행기를 가리키는 걸 정확히 듣고 답했어요.

choices.text: No, I'd like something tastier.
choices.kr: 아니, 좀 더 맛있는 게 좋아.
choices.explain: 'plane(비행기)'을 'plain(밋밋한)'으로 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: I thought you had the schedule.
choices.kr: 네가 일정 갖고 있는 줄 알았어.
choices.explain: 'plane'을 'plan(계획)'으로 들은 답이에요.

dialogue.text: How far is the gate from here?

choices.text: About a five-minute walk.
choices.explain: 탑승구까지 거리를 묻는 걸 정확히 듣고 답했어요.

choices.text: Around ten dollars, I think.
choices.explain: 'far(멀다)'를 'fare(요금)'로 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: Not long, maybe ten minutes.
choices.explain: 'how far'를 'how long is the wait'처럼 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: Yeah, let's line up.
choices.explain: 탑승할지 묻는 걸 정확히 듣고 답했어요.

choices.text: I know, the wait is so dull.
choices.explain: 'board(탑승)'를 'bored(지루한)'로 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: Let me check the departures board first.
choices.explain: 'board(탑승하다)'를 'the board(전광판)'로 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: Yes, you won't hear a thing.
choices.explain: 방이 조용하냐는 걸 정확히 듣고 답했어요.

choices.text: Yes, fairly big, actually.
choices.explain: 'quiet(조용한)'을 'quite(꽤)'로 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: It'll be ready by three.
choices.explain: 'quiet'을 놓치고 'is the room ready'처럼 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: Yes, at no extra cost.
choices.explain: 투어가 포함되냐는 걸 정확히 듣고 답했어요.

choices.text: The one up the hill has a lovely view.
choices.kr: 언덕 위 그건 전망이 참 좋아요.
choices.explain: 'tour(투어)'를 'tower(타워)'로 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: Breakfast is, but dinner isn't.
choices.explain: 'tour'를 놓치고 다른 포함 항목을 답한 오청이에요.

choices.text: Yes, it looks over the sea.
choices.explain: 전망이 좋냐는 걸 정확히 듣고 답했어요.

choices.text: Only a couple of rooms are left.
choices.explain: 'a view'를 'a few(몇 개)'로 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: Yes, it runs 24 hours a day.
choices.explain: 'view'를 놓치고 룸서비스 등을 묻는 말로 들은 답이에요.

dialogue.text: Is there a fee for a late return?

choices.text: Only if it's over an hour late.
choices.explain: 늦은 반납 요금을 묻는 걸 정확히 듣고 답했어요.

choices.text: No, returns cost you nothing.
choices.explain: 'fee(요금)'를 'free(무료)'로 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: Just leave the keys in the drop box.
choices.explain: 'fee'를 놓치고 반납 절차를 묻는 말로 들은 답이에요.

dialogue.text: Can I drop it off downtown?

choices.text: Sure, any of our branches works.
choices.explain: 시내 반납이 되냐는 걸 정확히 듣고 답했어요.

choices.text: Oh, I hope nothing broke.
choices.explain: 'drop it off(반납하다)'를 'drop it(떨어뜨리다)'로 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: Which town are you headed to?
choices.explain: 'downtown(시내)'을 'town(도시)'으로 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: Yes, I filled it up on the way.
choices.explain: 기름이 가득이냐는 걸 정확히 듣고 답했어요.

choices.text: Oh, you're welcome, no trouble at all.
choices.explain: 'the tank(연료통)'을 'thank(감사)'로 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: The window sticker's still on, yes.
choices.explain: 'tank'를 놓치고 차 상태 전반을 묻는 말로 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: No, it's just around the corner.
choices.explain: 박물관이 머냐는 걸 정확히 듣고 답했어요.

choices.text: Oh, that doesn't start until next week.
choices.explain: 'far(멀다)'를 'fair(축제/박람회)'로 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: Yes, it stays open until six.
choices.explain: 'far'를 놓치고 'is the museum open'처럼 들은 답이에요.

dialogue.text: Would you happen to know the way?

choices.text: Of course, just follow this road.
choices.explain: 길을 아냐는 걸 정확히 듣고 방향으로 답했어요.

choices.text: It's about two kilos, I'd guess.
choices.explain: 'the way(길)'를 'weigh(무게를 달다)'로 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: Oh no, was there an accident?
choices.explain: 'happen to know'를 'what happened'처럼 들은 답이에요.

dialogue.text: Can I get there on foot?

choices.text: Sure, it's a short walk.
choices.explain: 걸어갈 수 있냐는 걸 정확히 듣고 답했어요.

choices.text: There's a nice little place nearby.
choices.explain: 'on foot(걸어서)'을 'food(음식)'으로 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: The entrance is on Main Street.
choices.explain: 'on foot'을 놓치고 위치만 묻는 말로 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: Yes, for another hour.
choices.explain: 주방이 열려 있냐는 걸 정확히 듣고 답했어요.

choices.text: The spicy one is really popular.
choices.explain: 'kitchen(주방)'을 'chicken(치킨)'으로 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: The bar stays open until midnight.
choices.explain: 'kitchen'을 놓치고 다른 공간을 묻는 말로 들은 답이에요.

dialogue.text: Is it too late to order?

choices.text: Not at all, take your time.
choices.explain: 주문 가능하냐는 걸 정확히 듣고 답했어요.

choices.text: It's one of the oldest spots in town.
choices.explain: 'order(주문)'를 'older(더 오래된)'로 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: Sorry about the smell, I'll open a window.
choices.explain: 'order'를 'odor(냄새)'로 들은 답이에요.

dialogue.text: Then could I get the fried rice?

choices.text: Good choice, I'll put it in.
choices.explain: 볶음밥을 주문하는 걸 정확히 듣고 주문을 받았어요.

choices.text: Sure, I'll add some ice.
choices.explain: 'rice(밥)'를 'ice(얼음)'로 들은 답이에요.

choices.text: That comes to twelve dollars.
choices.explain: 'rice(밥)'를 'price(가격)'로 들은 답이에요.
